svg.title: Ali's showreel, work, code and edits
svg.desc: A silent, auto-playing 21-second showreel. The header reads Clearance: DoD Investigation in Progress on every clip. Seven clips show dates, results and tools, with a thin segmented progress bar and a clip counter. Reduced motion holds MIT LL. There are no controls.
